items.claim: Holding an `onPath` anchor on the wrong curve after an edit reverses its subpath
items.note: Where both segment anchors' origins are marked `reversed`, the pair is turned round, then put in the order `segmentBetween` gives. Still broken: a reversed two-anchor closed subpath (a lens). `editAnchorSetTracked`'s `runsBackward` never marks a lens as reversed, because walking either way visits the same neighbors. That is in `paths/anchorOrigins` (area geom.paths), outside this one, so I didn't fix it.

items.claim: `segmentBetween` can't answer a lens's closing segment
An item's own constraint naming an anchor past its path binds another item's anchor in `constrainPathsEdit`
items.note: Such a constraint is now dropped, as `constrainPathEdit` already drops it.

items.claim: A zero-length segment gives `length`/`equalLength` no gradient, so the solve can't open it
`anchorsBefore` takes an anchor added past an open subpath's end for its neighbor, so the end anchor's constraints move onto it
items.note: `PointOrigin` gains `made?: true`, set on every point of an anchor the edit made. That change has its own `minor` changeset (`geom-point-origin-made.md`) besides the fix's `patch` one.
